Scenario fixture: css-focus-indicator-suppressed

Each target has a stable id of the form cfis_case_NN. The rule reads focus styles out of the page's own stylesheets, so every case depends on the <style> block above.

Not covered here: rules in a shadow root's sheets, and the rules that reach across a shadow tree's edge (::part(), ::slotted(), :host). jsdom builds no shadow root from markup, so the rule's tests attach the roots from script instead.
